title: Student Record Manager
description:
Create a Python program to manage a student's basic information using a dictionary.

The program must:
1. Read 5 lines from standard input:
   - Student Name (string)
   - Student Age (integer)
   - Initial Mark (integer)
   - Course Name (string)
   - Updated Mark (integer)
2. Create a dictionary containing `'name'`, `'age'`, and `'mark'`.
3. Access and print `'name'`, `'age'`, and initial `'mark'` using dictionary keys.
4. Add a new key called `'course'` to the dictionary and print it.
5. Update the student's `'mark'` to the updated mark and print it.
6. Check whether the `'course'` key exists using the `in` operator and print whether it is available.
7. Print the final dictionary.

### Output Format
```text
Name: <name>
Age: <age>
Mark: <initial_mark>
Course: <course>
Updated Mark: <updated_mark>
Course Available: <True/False>
Final Record: <dictionary>
```
requirements: Read all 5 input values from standard input.
Print fields using dictionary key lookups.
